question: Arun and Aditya can complete a work separately in 8 days and 12 days, respectively. After 2 days of working alone, Aditya leaves the work, In how many days Arun will complete the remaining work?
solution:
**Given data:**

Arun can complete a work in 8 days

Aditya can complete the same work in 12 days

Aditya worked for 2 days

**Concept:** The work done is the ratio of the number of days worked to the total time required to complete the work.

**Solution:**

⇒ Work done by Aditya in 2 days = 2/12 = 1/6 of the total work

⇒ Remaining work = 1 - 1/6 = 5/6

⇒ Time taken by Arun to complete the remaining work = (5/6) x 8 = 20/3 days = 6(2)/(3) days

**Hence, Arun will complete the remaining work in 6 2/3 days. The correct answer is 4) 6(2)/(3) days.**
